desc: Coordinate-compress nums and slide left/right frequency arrays over the middle index (O(n·m)).
Accumulate f=5,4,3 cases via binomial products (always valid since x's count strictly beats any other).
Implement f=2 correction via Sp,Sq,T1,T2,T3 over v!=x, giving Lx*A + Rx*B (verified derivation: excludes coincident non-x values).
Verify by execution: examples (6,4,0), randomized brute-force cross-check n ≤ 9, and n=1000 all-equal stress producing C(1000,5) mod 1e9+7.
